name: Google
description: Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Tasks and Contacts for the assistant, on your own Google account, asking before every change.
author: Jaron Wilson

steps.title: Google files and tasks for the assistant
steps.body: This add-on lets the assistant search, read and write your **Google Drive**, **Docs**, **Sheets** and **Slides**, and use **Google Tasks** and **Contacts**. Google Calendar and Meet stay in Odysseus (Settings > Google).

steps.title: Set up the OAuth client
steps.body:
Use the Google Cloud OAuth client Odysseus already has. Add this add-on's **redirect URI** (shown on its page, ending in `/mods/google/oauth/callback`) under Authorized redirect URIs, and enable the Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Tasks and People APIs.

Already used these in Odysseus? An admin carries the client and your connection over with one command from the README (`odysseus_google.import_from_core`), so you do not connect again.

steps.title: Connect what you want
steps.body: Press **Connect** on each product card. Google opens in a new tab: keep every box ticked, then come back. **Read all my Drive files** widens Drive from the files the assistant made to your whole Drive (read only).

steps.title: It asks before every change
steps.body: Creating or editing a Doc, writing a Sheet, uploading to Drive or adding a task waits in the chat for your **Approve**. Reading never asks. The switch is under **Ask before writing**.

steps.title: Ask the assistant
steps.body: In a chat, try *find my google doc about the trip*, *add a row to my budget spreadsheet* or *make a google slides deck from these notes*. Results end with a link to the file.
